title: Private Mobile Radio devices
text:
Regulation
For the service of Private Mobile Radio
devices operating at 446 MHz
Version 2/2018

Article 1
Definitions:
A - The authorisation: The statement that allows the operation of PMR
446 devices by the user in the specified frequency bands and subject to the
conditions stipulated in these regulations.
B - Device or devices (PMR 446): A device or Private Mobile Radio
devices operating at 446 MHz frequency.
C -Seller: A company or an establishment that has a permit issued by the
Authority for trading in telecommunication devices.
D - Special form: Registration form specified for this service by the
Authority.
E - User: is a natural or legal person, company or institution (governmental
or non-governmental).
F - Repeater: a station receiving and transmitting frequencies to increase
the coverage area.
G – Type Approval Certificate: A certificate for the approval of technical
specifications for telecommunications equipment.
1

Article (2)
Terms for users:
A - The user shall assume full legal responsibility for all the
communications that are made by using the device.
B - In the event of loss or damage to the device, the user must notify the
Communication & Information Technology Regulatory Authority and the
Ministry of the Interior within a maximum period of seven (7) days from its
date.
C - To use the devices responsibly, efficiently and assumes full legal
responsibility in the event of any abuse in use.
D - Not to sell or dispose of the devices without informing the
Communication & Information Technology Regulatory Authority.
E - The equipment shall be purchased from an authorised seller at the
Communication & Information Technology Regulatory Authority.
F - The user must fill out the special form of the Communication &
Information Technology Regulatory Authority at the time of purchase.
2

Article (3)
Seller Terms:
A - Has a valid permit issued by the Authority for trading in wireless
devices.
B - Upon request to import PMR446 equipment, the seller must submit all
the technical specifications and catalogs of these devices.
C - Obtain a Type Approval Certificate for these devices.
D - Keep a record of the users of these devices and the addresses of their
use, purpose, and submit it annually or at any time requested by the
Authority.
Article (4)
Technical specifications of devices:
A - Hand-held devices shall only use the built-in device antenna as a fixed,
non-detachable part of the device and operate only within the band (446
MHz-446.2 MHz).
B - The transmitting power of the device shall not exceed 500 mW.
C – The use of a repeater or base station for these devices is not allowed.
D - The equipment must comply with the European Standard ETSI TS 102
490 Digital, ETSI TS 103 236 Analogue.
3

Article (5)
This Regulation and any of its terms are subject to change by the
Communication & Information Technology Regulatory Authority.
4
